description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: Preparing for Next-Generation Geohazards is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Kaleigh Yost, Penn State University (psu.edu). This poster, presented at the Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024, highlights two ongoing projects of the Yost Research Group, one focused on earthquake and climate hazards in New Zealand and the other focused on flood hazard in Pennsylvania. Once data collection is completed for these projects, it will be available on DesignSafe for reuse. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-q511-8d07. Keywords: eartthquake; flood; levees; geophysical; climate; resilience; geohazards. Published 2024-07-18. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
